fixture_notice: Entirely synthetic English documents and independently authored expectations for a narrow privileged-human-administrator MFA regression set. Metadata is a declared inventory and is not independently authenticated.

SYNTHETIC Acme Analytics administrator access policy, approved 2026-10-01.
Scope: Acme Analytics production; all human administrators, including emergency administrators.
Every human administrator must use enforced phishing-resistant MFA for production administrative access.
Only FIDO2 or WebAuthn implementations with verified origin binding, verifier binding and multiple factors are permitted.
Fallback, account recovery and emergency access must meet the same authentication requirement.
This policy states required behavior; it is not a configuration export or evidence of operating tests.

SYNTHETIC configuration export captured 2026-10-12 for Acme Analytics production.
The export covers all 24 human administrators, including the two emergency administrators, and the complete enabled authentication path inventory.
MFA is enabled and enforced for all 24 human administrators; no administrator can obtain an administrative session without the enforced factors.
The sole enabled authentication path is primary-admin, using deployed FIDO2 security keys plus each key's local PIN; possession and PIN verification are both required.
For this deployed primary-admin path, the client validates the Acme Analytics origin and the verifier validates the relying-party binding before issuing a session.
Fallback authentication paths are disabled for the entire administrator population.
Recovery requires two custodians to authorize registration of a replacement FIDO2 key with a PIN; no administrative session can be issued until the same origin-bound, verifier-bound multifactor challenge succeeds.
The complete administrator and authentication-path inventories contain no exemptions or weaker alternate paths.

SYNTHETIC operating test executed 2026-10-14 for Acme Analytics production human administrators.
The tester reconciled the current directory inventory and exercised every one of the 24 administrator accounts, including emergency administrators.
All 24 administrative login attempts required the deployed FIDO2 key plus PIN; wrong-origin and wrong-relying-party challenges were rejected, and attempts without either factor failed.
The tester exercised every documented fallback and recovery workflow; fallback login failed, and replacement-key recovery issued no session before the replacement key plus PIN satisfied the same origin and verifier checks.
No administrator exemptions, MFA bypasses, weaker active authentication paths or operating-test exceptions were found in the complete tested inventory.

scenarios.review_notes: Positive control only after independent analyst review confirms each typed fact against full context. FIDO2 branding alone supplies none of the implementation properties. The test covers the entire stated human administrator population and complete alternate-path inventory.
